jobs.occupation: Warehouse Employee / Order Picker / Dutch not required
jobs.description:
For us, your attitude and reliability are more important than your CV or education.

You are reliable and like to get things done
You work carefully and at a good pace
You can work independently and as part of a team
You can communicate in basic English / English is our main working language, but you don't need to speak it fluently. Dutch is not required
You can easily travel to our warehouse in Duiven

MyBoeken is growing! We are looking for 1/2 new colleagues to join our warehouse team in Duiven for approximately 20 hours per week.
We are an online bookstore shipping books to customers throughout Europe. Together with the team, you make sure customer orders are picked, packed and shipped correctly and on time.

What will you do?
Pick books from our warehouse
Pack customer orders
Prepare parcels for shipment
Process incoming stock
Help keep the warehouse organised
Who are we looking for?
For us, your attitude and reliability are more important than your CV or education.
You are reliable and like to get things done
You work carefully and at a good pace
You can work independently and as part of a team
You can communicate in basic English / English is our main working language, but you don't need to speak it fluently. Dutch is not required
You can easily travel to our warehouse in Duiven
You are available for approximately 20 hours per week
No warehouse experience or specific diploma is required. We will show you everything you need to know.

What do we offer?
Approximately 20 hours per week
Flexible working hours, to be discussed together
A good salary based on age and experience
Daytime working hours
A small, friendly and international team
A relaxed and informal atmosphere, we work hard, but there's always room for music and a laugh

jobs.occupation: ALLROUND MASSAGETHERAPIST SPECIALIZED IN BALINESE & THAI MASSAGE
jobs.description:
Wo are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

Minimum of 1 year of professional experience as a massage therapist and also proficient in Thai and Balinese massage techniques.  Proven ability to perform full-body massage treatments of up to 30-60 minutes. Experience with deep tissue, sports, wellness, or traditional massage techniques. Experience in a spa, wellness centre, or massage clinic is preferred. Knowledge of, or experience with medical massage is a plus. Works with attention, care, and passion for your profession. You are qualified with a relevant diploma or certificate, which is a must.

Ability to work independently and maintain high service standards.
Physically fit and capable of performing multiple treatments per day.
 Good communication skills in English is required. 

Furthermore, you are:
- Communicative and customer-focused
- Sociable, flexible, and stress-resistant
- Professional and quality-conscious
- A true team player

KrungThong Spa is a charming and professional wellness center in Rijswijk, where guests enjoy authentic Thai and Balinese massages in a relaxing atmosphere. We are immediately seeking a (female) all-round massage therapist, specialized in Balinese and/or Thai massage, to join our team. There are two positions open.

What do we offer?

- A busy schedule with many regular clients
- Competitive salary, including holiday pay and holiday leave
- Flexible working hours and vacation days upon request
- Regular staff outings and team-building activities are organized to promote a positive and enjoyable working environment.
- A pleasant working atmosphere in a professional team

- Minimum of 5 years of experience as a nail technician
- Experience with Russian and Japanese manicure, BIAB, acrylic(gel), polygel, gel polish and nail art
- Experience of at least 1 year in a professional nail salon in Europe
- You have a strong social media presence with a minimum of 15k followers
- You are a creative social media brain (Instagram and TikTok). You shoot and edit vlogs and other beauty related content 
- You speak English and other languages are a plus
- You are detail-oriented, professional, reliable and motivated

We have upgraded to a bigger, better and more chic salon location in Amsterdam, and we are looking for talented nail technicians to grow with us.

Are you a skilled nail technician with a passion for beauty, precision, client experience and social media? Do you want work in a stylish salon environment, build a loyal clientele and help create inspiring beauty content? Then Ezoncs Amsterdam is looking for you.

Ezoncs is an established beauty brand with successful salons in Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht and Amsterdam. After two strong years in Amsterdam, we have taken the next step with a renewed and upgraded salon in the same street.

This means a fresh space, a chic atmosphere, higher standards and more opportunities for your growth.

What you will do
- Deliver high-quality manicures, pedicures and full nail care treatments.
- Create clean, precise and Instagram-worthy results.
- Build strong relationships with clients and develop your own loyal clientele.
- Maintain the highest standards of hygiene, professionalism and client care.
- Create engaging beauty-focused content for Instagram and TikTok.
- Film and edit short-form videos, vlogs and behind-the-scenes salon content.
- Showcase nail transformations, beauty treatments and salon highlights through social media.
- Stay up to date with beauty and social media trends to help grow the Ezoncs brand online.
- Act as a brand ambassador and beauty influencer for Ezoncs, helping to inspire and engage our online community.

jobs.employer_name: Babaji Shivram Shipping and Logistics B.V.
jobs.description:
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially aware and comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment.

4to 6 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, shipping, transport or supply-chain operations.
Strong understanding of international freight and export/import processes.
Existing network of freight forwarders, carriers, transporters, customs brokers or logistics service providers.
Strong coordination and communication skills.
Good understanding of logistics documentation and shipment processes.
Strong Excel / Microsoft Office skills.
Excellent written and verbal Dutch & English.
Experience in the Rotterdam / Netherlands logistics market.
Knowledge of European customs procedures.

About the Opportunity: 
We are building our European operations from the ground up with Rotterdam as our base in the Netherlands. We are looking for an ambitious and hands-on Export Pricing & Operations Coordinator to join us at this exciting stage. 

You will be one of the first people on the ground.

You will work closely and directly with the management team to help establish our logistics operations in the Netherlands, from identifying and onboarding vendors, building relationships with freight partners to developing pricing, coordinating shipments, establishing processes and supporting customer requirements.

About The Company: 
We are an established global logistics and supply-chain organisation with extensive experience across freight forwarding, customs clearance, transportation, warehousing and international supply-chain solutions. We have offices across the globe - US, China, Dubai, Oman, Saudi, Singapore, Canada and 22 offices within India. 

As part of our international expansion, we are now establishing our European presence from Rotterdam.

Our ambition is to develop the Netherlands into an important operational and commercial hub for our European activities and build a strong, reliable network across Europe.

As a Transit Terminal Operator, you will work in the cross-dock warehouse at DACHSER in Waddinxveen, part of our Logistics Centre Rotterdam in the Netherlands. Together with your colleagues, you make sure that goods are loaded, unloaded and processed safely, accurately and on time. 
You will work with an electric pallet truck (EPT) and a handheld scanner. As our logistics operation runs around the clock, you may work different shifts depending on the operation and your availability. 
"Together, we make sure every shipment leaves safely and on time." 
Your main tasks are: - Loading and unloading trailers and swap bodies. - Moving pallets with an electric pallet truck (EPT). - Scanning goods with a handheld scanner. - Placing goods in the correct location in the warehouse. - Checking whether goods are properly packed. - Reporting damage or other issues to your supervisor. 
Working hours 
You work 40 hours per week. You can work different shifts, depending on the operation and your availability. 
Possible shifts include: - Morning shift - Afternoon/evening shift - Night shift 
Together, we will look at which shift works best for you. 
Who are you? - You enjoy active and physical work. - You work well with colleagues. - You work safely and accurately. - You are flexible with working hours. - You speak Dutch or English. - You are available full-time. About DACHSER 
Logistics is People Business - this vision underlines the fact that our people are the driving force behind DACHSER's success.

Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that millions of flowers and plants are delivered to the right customers on time every day.
